name: Witch's Revelation: Instruction Beyond Dreams
description: You encounter Yumemizuki Mizuki at Barbeloth's fortune-telling booth...

steps.description: Finish listening to Yumemizuki Mizuki's story

dialogs.content: Huh? Isn't that Mizuki and her two mini baku? Are they talking to Barbeloth already?
#{NICKNAME} and Paimon...? Lady Barbeloth was just talking about you. I was wondering if we might cross paths.
Hehe... It seems like fate has already arranged our meeting place.
Are you here on holiday, Mizuki?

Hmm... I suppose you could say that. If the prep work for this educational film about psychology I'm doing goes smoothly, I should indeed have time for some leisure. Though until then, I still need to focus on my work.
A film about psychology?
Whoa, films can do that? That's amazing!
Mmhmm, it's a new idea I came up with. Back when I was promoting Aisa Bathhouse, I took inspiration from Fontainian cinema and recorded a few variety show episodes.
People seemed to love it. Not only did they watch every episode, they even remembered all the psychological concepts we showcased.
So I thought, why not make a few films about mental disorders as a fun and educational way to explain basic psychological concepts.
...If I can raise everyone's basic awareness, perhaps people can develop a more objective understanding of what mental disorders are.
...Perhaps I can stop people from blindly dismissing these conditions as made-up nonsense, or treating them like some terrifying bogeyman.
And maybe my future therapy sessions will go a little more smoothly...
You've clearly put a lot of thought into this...
That's right. After all, illnesses of the mind are invisible and hard to pin down. Trying to get a hold on them, or even just detecting their existence, is sometimes far from easy.
But even I don't know how to pin them down to fit neatly into a script...
I'm a bit embarrassed to admit it, but even though I've written quite a few papers about mental health, I'm completely stuck when it comes to writing a film script.
Sometimes, I stay cooped up in my room all day, endlessly going over a few lines of dialogue or a few seconds of plot... Even then, I might come away with nothing to show at the end of it.
That sounds exhausting...
#Maybe you're just missing a little spark of inspiration? When Paimon and {NICKNAME} get stuck on one thing, we do something else, and then... *ding*! The answer just pops into our heads!
Hmm, it seems like great minds think alike, Paimon. That's why I came here, to experience a form of divination quite unlike the fortune slips I'm used to.
I'm hoping this mage's Lunar Arcana can bring me some fresh inspiration.
Inspiration... Anya once said that she wanted to write a fairy tale for every card in the Lunar Arcana. But there were so many stories she wanted to write, and so little time... Heh...
Since you're looking for inspiration, go ahead and draw a card, Miss Youkai. I hope that mage's unfinished fairy tale can lead you to the inspiration for your own story.
Alright, Lady Barbeloth. But... most of what I know about divination relates to... the Grand Narukami Shrine. Fortune telling with cards is a first for me.
If I do anything that breaks the proper ritual etiquette, please set me straight.
Oh my, the reversed Moon...
The upright and reversed meanings of the Moon are similar — "escapism," "illusion," "self-deception"...
Like someone traveling beneath a dark moon, having lost their way forward but not knowing how to break free.
That doesn't sound good...
Yeah, why does the meaning of this card sound like a warning...? Paimon's got a really bad feeling about this...
However, since Miss Yumemizuki can still hear this prophecy, it means the situation is not yet too dire.
With a little effort, you may be able to exit the haze that obscures your path ahead, and find what you seek...
Escapism, illusion... and "self-deception"?
Taking the card at face value, yes. To put it more plainly...
You're running from an answer that's right before your eyes, searching far when you should be looking near.
Are you saying there's someone who can review my script standing right in front of me?
It's not limited to just the script... But how you interpret the meaning behind the card is entirely up to you.
The answer is right in front of my eyes, yet I'm searching far when I should be looking near... I think I understand what you're getting at.
Heh... When you put it like that, I really have been deceiving myself... Or rather, I couldn't help but "search far when I should be looking near."
I thought about visiting Yae Publishing House and asking Guuji Yae for advice, but then...
From a clinical perspective, I suppose this counts as "unconscious avoidance"...
Thank you for your divination, Lady Barbeloth. You really helped me find inspiration after all.
There's no need to thank me. I did nothing. You untangled the threads of fate yourself. I merely placed the loose ends in your hands.
However, Guuji Yae is also someone swept along by fate.
Intertwining threads often bring trouble. With that in mind, keeping your distance wouldn't necessarily be a bad thing.
If I simply ask for some feedback on my script, surely that wouldn't bring fate into the mix, would it?
As I said, how you interpret things is not up to me, Miss Yumemizuki. I cannot see every twist in your future from reading a single card.
Who can perceive every obstacle on the path of fate before it trips them up?
Sometimes, it's just like that little brat said...
"...Fate is called as such, for it cannot be changed, nor can it be reversed. It can only but be accepted."
Anyway, Miss Youkai, I look forward to watching your film. Hehehe...
That sounds a little negative...
You need to relax...
You've really considered this thoroughly...
Is this a new form of therapy?
